dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid light-colored punctate clusters is localized on the anterior-dorsal region and lower lateral flank, characterized by uniform pixel intensity without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the dorsal mid-section form a wide-angled scalene triangle extending along the longitudinal axis of the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, light-colored mystacial vibrissae are visible against the dark-toned facial pixels.
